scope: Pre-GPU audit of the fail-closed Experiment 004 v10 scientific-validity schema, raw-evidence bindings, and postprocessor construction.
findings: The v2 object exposes exactly the 23 booleans mandated by section 27; no legacy boolean alias can silently enter the conjunction.

scientifically_valid is accepted only as the conjunction of all 23 evidence-bound booleans, a complete causal timeline, and an empty invalid-reason set; a missing or null boolean fails strict validation.
Authorization, phase budget, two-engine readiness, both short sanity guards, settlement, and cleanup are bound through seven content-addressed prerequisite references.

GPU1 state release and allocator-visible HBM capacity reclamation are distinct gates. HBM reclamation requires an unchanged KV-pool reservation, exact assigned-to-unassigned byte conversion, and release before serving enable.
Bounded backlog is recomputed from the complete offered/observed request bijection from spike start through GPU1 first useful service, and is bound to the precommitted trigger and abort depths.
SLO restoration and the full five-second stability window remain separate required booleans, and GPU0 restore activity is measured across H2D, import, native write, validation, and branch resume.
The fail-closed constructor emits every required boolean as false and never treats absent evidence as approval.

test_evidence.command: PYTHONPATH=python:experiments/branchfabric uv run --locked pytest -q tests/python/test_experiment_004_accounting.py tests/python/test_gpu_reclamation_v10_validity.py tests/python/test_experiment_004_v10_scientific_contract.py tests/python/test_experiment_004_gpu_harness.py -k 'movement or scientific or v10 or accounting or fail_closed'
